title: Rate-limit-aware transaction efficiency
summary: Measure API calls per authorized transition and reduce redundant immutable reads while honoring rate-limit cooldown, bounded retries and fresh mutable-state checks. Compare matched workloads at different logical client counts.

origin.source: Owner-directed VIB engineering research and independent implementation discussion, 2026-11-25; source-level provenance retained separately.

benefits: Lower API pressure and reproducible performance comparisons
risks: Caching mutable refs or ignoring cooldown can undermine correctness; simulations are not actual independent-agent trials

evidence.claim: Existing VIB candidate context only; does not establish implementation or acceptance of this idea.
